integrity: A symbolic all-population Fourier/Hodge projection proof is paired with an exact rational direct-rank checker. Earlier published witness and positive semidefiniteness results are explicitly attributed. No independent validation or publication-priority certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete conflict graph, binary priorities, deterministic total-order ties and uniform unilateral-edge energy. The explicit quadratic family proves strict affine suboptimality for every integer population at least eight; optimal nonlinear shares are not determined. Published results resolve smaller populations.
title: The exact population threshold for binary-priority affine extremality
